meta.hierarchyProjection: USD whole/Part/section hierarchy with RB, OA and XB side by side, followed by a stable budget-unit tier. Printed entities remain entities; section-wide, programme, special-purpose and unitemized scopes use explicit neutral wrappers. Deeper rows preserve each selected source schedule instead of claiming one universal entity/component/subprogramme order. Independently printed parents remain authoritative; a source-control difference is retained only as normalized reconciliation metadata, never as treemap expenditure. Selected lower outline: 180 source tables, 928 printed observations and 463 materialized lower nodes; 139 parallel tables and 2 other-currency tables remain outside additive arithmetic.
